user.title: NetBird
user.description: Connect a self-hosted NetBird management server.

data_description.url: Base URL of the NetBird dashboard, for example https://netbird.example.com. A trailing /api is removed.
data_description.token: Personal access token of a service user. Role auditor is enough for monitoring, control needs admin.
data_description.verify_ssl: Turn off only for self-signed certificates.

reauth_confirm.title: Renew access token
reauth_confirm.description: The token for {url} is no longer valid. Create a new token for the service user and paste it here.

data_description.token: Personal access token of a service user. Role auditor is enough for monitoring, control needs admin.

error.cannot_connect: Server not reachable. Check the URL and the network path.
error.insufficient_permissions: The token is valid, but may not read peers.
error.invalid_response: The server answered, but not like a NetBird management API.

abort.already_configured: This management server is already configured.
abort.different_instance: The URL belongs to a different management server.

init.title: NetBird options
init.description: Control functions are off by default. Each one needs a service user with the admin role.

data_description.scan_interval: How often the management server is queried.
data_description.token_warning_days: Create a repair issue this many days before the access token expires.
data_description.audit_events: Fire a netbird_audit_event for every new audit log entry and add the last event sensor.
data_description.control_policies: Adds a switch per access policy. Requires the admin role.
data_description.control_networks: Adds switches for network resources and routing peers. Requires the admin role.
data_description.control_peers: Allows the actions approve peer, set login expiration and delete peer.
data_description.control_users: Allows the actions approve, reject and block user.
data_description.control_groups: Allows the actions add and remove a peer from a group.
data_description.control_setup_keys: Allows the actions create and revoke setup key.

token_expiring.title: NetBird token expires soon
token_expiring.description: The access token used by {title} expires on {date}. Create a new token for the service user in the NetBird dashboard and enter it via Reconfigure.

missing_permissions.title: NetBird control needs more permissions
missing_permissions.description: Control functions are enabled for {title}, but the service user may not change: {modules}. Give the service user the admin role or turn these options off.

control_disabled.message: This action is turned off in the options of {title}.

entry_not_found.message: NetBird entry not found or not loaded.

entry_ambiguous.message: Several NetBird servers are configured, choose one.

peer_not_found.message: The device is not a known NetBird peer.

permission_denied.message: The service user lacks permission for this action (role admin required).

cannot_block_self.message: The service user used by this integration cannot block itself.
